description: Recall is typed, durable memory and state for AI agents. It stores corrections, decisions and task state as append-only records in your own object store (S3 or GCS), so an agent can be corrected without retraining and resumed after a crash, restart or pod replacement without snapshotting the process. Go library, recall binary (MCP and HTTP), Python client polign-recall.
rules: Install the Python client with pip install polign-recall; it brings the recall binary and a local polign_db database, so no separate server is needed to start.
Use remember(text=...) and ask(question) for text memory; a newer fact replaces an older one and the old value stays under before and in history.
Use Client(agent=True).resume(agent_id) for agent state: working state, turns, outputs, pointers and actions, fenced by a lease.
For LangGraph use recall-langgraph (RecallResume, RecallSaver, RecallStore); for the OpenAI Agents SDK use recall-openai-agents (RecallSession); for Pydantic AI use recall-pydantic-ai (RecallMemory).
